---------------------



Taskrabbit is a marketplace platform that conveniently connects people with Taskers to handle everyday home to\-do's, such as furniture assembly, handyman work, moving help, and much more.

We're looking for talented, entrepreneurially minded and data\-driven people who also have a passion for helping people do what they love. Together with IKEA, we're creating more opportunities for people to earn a consistent, meaningful income on their own terms by building lasting relationships with clients in communities around the world.



Taskrabbit is a hybrid company with employees distributed across the US and EU and a Built In — Best Places to Work (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025\) continually ranked across multiple national and regional categories. Join us at Taskrabbit, where your work will be meaningful, your ideas valued, and your potential unleashed!

**This role operates on a hybrid schedule requiring two days of in\-office collaboration per week. The position will be based out of our San Francisco office.**

-----------------


The Server Operations team monitors the physical and network infrastructure behind Google’s technology and holds responsibility for keeping the servers, networks, and logistics processes in Google’s global fleet of data centers running smoothly and efficiently.


Google's projects, like our users, span the globe and require managers to keep the big picture in focus while being able to dive into the unique engineering challenges we face daily. Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

* Background in assembly, machining, lab work, or skilled trades

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.title: IT Operations Lead
jobs.description:
**About the team and the role**
-------------------------------


Mind Robotics is building intelligent robotic systems. Our work happens on\-site across active hardware labs, test floors, and compute environments where hardware and software iterate together daily.


As our first dedicated IT hire, you will build and own our IT operations end to end. You’ll be responsible for making sure our teams never lose momentum to tooling, identity, device, or network issues, whether that means troubleshooting a Linux/driver setup in the lab, setting up zero\-touch laptop provisioning for new hires, or ensuring our test\-floor Wi\-Fi can handle high\-throughput robot telemetry.


We believe modern IT should be built for extreme leverage. In this role, you will actively use AI agents and build agentic workflows (leveraging LLMs, MCP, and API integrations) to automate support intake, triage, provisioning, access approvals, and system reconciliation. You'll build an AI\-native IT foundation that keeps operations fast, lean, and scalable without scaling support headcount.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own internal IT \& support: Be the primary technical point of contact for the team. Establish a lightweight, responsive support workflow that unblocks engineers quickly without unnecessary red tape.
* Build agentic automations \& workflows: Leverage AI coding agents and LLM\-driven workflows (via APIs, MCP, webhooks) to automate repetitive IT operations: such as intelligent ticket triage, access requests, onboarding/offboarding, and system reconciliation.
* Manage identity, access, and endpoints: Administer our core SaaS, identity, and access stack (Google Workspace / IdP) and deploy modern MDM (e.g., Fleet, Jamf) for zero\-touch provisioning and fleet visibility across macOS, Windows, and Linux machines.
* Support robotics lab \& compute infrastructure: Help maintain our lab workstation fleet (Ubuntu boxes, test bench PCs), keeping configurations reliable and reproducible.
* Design and maintain office \& lab networking: Manage local network infrastructure \- VLAN segmentation (isolating robot telemetry, test benches, and corporate traffic), Wi\-Fi reliability in dense RF lab environments, managed switches, and ISP circuits.
* Manage hardware \& procurement: Own hardware ordering, inventory tracking, vendor relationships, conference room AV, and hands\-on physical lab IT setup (racking, cabling, and workstation rollouts).

**Requirements**
----------------

* Experience: 6\+ years of hands\-on IT operations, systems administration, or IT engineering experience, ideally in a fast\-paced startup, hardware, or robotics environment.
* AI \& Agentic fluency: Active user of AI coding tools and agents (Cursor, Claude Code, LLM APIs) to accelerate development, with experience or strong interest in building agentic/LLM\-assisted workflows for operations.
* Multi\-OS troubleshooting: Strong troubleshooting skills across macOS, Windows, and Linux (Ubuntu) at the OS, driver, and application layers.
* Networking fundamentals: Practical hands\-on experience configuring managed switches, subnets, VLANs, DNS/DHCP, VPN, and robust Wi\-Fi networks.
* AI \& MCP integrations: Experience deploying LLM agents, MCP servers, or AI\-native internal tools useing Python, JS, Git, or Bash for IT/Ops automation.
* Identity \& MDM: Hands\-on experience administering nterprise identity (Google Workspace, Okta) and modern MDM platforms (Fleet, Jamf, Intune, or equivalent).
* Hands\-on facility readiness: Willingness to work on\-site and handle physical infrastructure: racking equipment, running and terminating cable, and supporting all types of hardware in an active lab and office environment.
* Robotics \& ML: Experience supporting robotics environments, ROS, or GPU/CUDA machine learning workstations (is a plus).
* Facility scaling: Experience managing IT infrastructure through a new facility buildout or office/lab move (is a plus).

You'll own the relationship between Prepory and the parents and guardians of the students we serve, from the orientation calls through final admissions decisions, and you'll make sure the experience a family signed up for is the experience they actually get.  

This is a client\-facing, relationship\-driven role. You'll run new student orientations and parent check\-in meetings, serve as the escalation point when a family's expectations and a coach's approach fall out of alignment, and mentor our college admissions coaches on how to navigate hard conversations and complicated family dynamics. When a family is ready to add programming or re\-enroll for another year, you'll be the person they trust enough to ask.  

You'll also maintain a cohort of up to 15 students. That caseload is deliberately small, because the majority of your hours belong to client success. Coaching a few students keeps you close to the advising experience you represent to parents every day.  

You'll report to our Client Success Director and work alongside our Program Directors, Program Managers, Enrollment team, and coaching team. **What You'll Do**

### **Own the family relationship**

* Conduct new student orientation sessions that set clear expectations for the program and each family's role in it.
* Run parent check\-in meetings alongside the student's coach, translating student progress into terms families understand and can act on.
* Communicate proactively with parents and guardians so concerns surface early, while there's still time to solve them.
* Serve as the point of escalation for families whose expectations, needs, or dynamics call for a steadier hand, and know when to bring in the Client Success Director.
* Handle difficult conversations with disappointed or anxious families directly, calmly, and with a solutions\-oriented attitude.

### **Support and protect the coaching relationship**

* Serve as the point of contact and escalation for college admissions coaches navigating client concerns, expectations, and family dynamics.
* Mentor coaches on client communication, individualized student needs, and the situations that don't have a playbook.
* Collaborate with coaches and program leadership to adjust programming when a student's needs change.

### **Grow the relationship**

* Recognize when a family is ready for more, and introduce the Prepory programming that fits: college tours, UK admissions support, graduate and professional school admissions, and enrichment and research planning.
* Own re\-enrollments for the families you serve, and carry the commercial conversation with the same care you bring to every other conversation.
* Champion referral and review strategies, including mentoring coaches on leveraging their relationship with families to drive positive reviews and referrals to friends and family.

### **Coach a cohort of up to 15 students**

* Conduct regular one\-on\-one advising sessions with your students, from profile building through final decisions.
* Advise students through the writing process for personal statements, supplemental essays, and résumés, providing meaningful, actionable feedback.
* Track each student's deadlines and assign tasks between sessions to keep them on pace.
* Help students research and build a balanced college list that reflects their academic and professional interests.

 **What You Bring**

* Admissions knowledge you can draw on in real time. You'll be on live calls with families who ask hard, specific questions. You need to answer most of them with confidence, and recognize the rest quickly enough to say you'll follow up rather than guess.
* Composure with any family in the room. Orientations and check\-ins put you in front of every kind of parent, from the entirely hands\-off to the deeply anxious.
* Real comfort with the commercial side of the work. We are looking for someone who is excited when a conversation turns to renewals, add\-on programming, or enrolling a second child, and who treats it as the natural extension of a relationship they've earned.
* Availability to work at least one evening per week and 12 Saturdays or Sundays per year.
* Impeccable listening, speaking, writing, and grammar skills, along with excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* The ability to manage competing priorities in a fast\-moving environment, including peak season, when orientations, check\-ins, and application deadlines all land at once.

**Qualifications of Our Ideal Candidate**
-----------------------------------------

* Graduated from a selective or highly\-selective college or university (top\-50 national university or top\-20 liberal arts college preferred).
* Three or more years of experience in college admissions, admissions consulting, or a closely related field. Experience inside an admissions office is a strong plus.
* Detailed, current knowledge of the U.S. college admissions process, and a willingness to stay current

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, Campaign Delivery
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

Triadex is a full\-service data analysis, direct marketing, and digital agency working with national name brands and multi\-unit franchises across restaurant, home services, after\-market, dental, and related industries. We provide customer analysis, segmentation, direct mail, digital advertising, and other high\-ROI campaigns, with performance metrics on every activity we perform. Our approach is highly consultative: we pair excellent service with cutting\-edge recommendations that drive sales.

**Role Summary**

The Senior Project Manager owns end\-to\-end delivery of campaigns across a portfolio of client accounts, from pre\-production through in\-home delivery. This is the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks \- and who spots the crack before anything falls through it.

Direct mail is unforgiving. Dates are real, print slots are finite, and a tracking code or store\-match error caught after release becomes an expensive problem. This role exists to make that never happen, and to make the process feel effortless from the client's side even when it isn't behind the scenes.

The Senior Project Manager is expected to operate with a high degree of independence: identifying gaps and risks early, pulling in the right internal people to resolve them, and driving issues to closure without waiting to be asked. Alongside campaign delivery, this role safeguards the financial hygiene of each program \- insertion orders issued, payments secured before release to print, invoicing accurate and on time.

This is a growth seat. We are looking for someone with the appetite and aptitude to expand their scope over time, into process ownership, mentorship of junior coordinators, and eventually broader operational or account leadership.

**Responsibilities**

**1\. Campaign Delivery Ownership**

* Own the delivery schedule and launch date for every campaign in an assigned portfolio, holding all parties — client, internal teams, and third\-party providers — accountable to their deadlines.

**2\. Proactive Problem Solving**

* Identify risks and gaps before they become delays: a missing approval, an unclear spec, a client deliverable trending late, a vendor going quiet.
* Diagnose the actual problem rather than escalating symptoms, and arrive at the conversation with a recommended path forward.
* Know the organization well enough to loop in the right internal partner quickly — Data Analytics, Creative, Print, Operations, Finance, or Digital Partners — and bring them the specific context they need to act.
* Escalate early and clearly when a date is genuinely at risk, with impact and options laid out.
* Solve the logistical problems that arise mid\-flight — distribution issues, delivery timing, address or targeting complications — and communicate their resolution proactively.

**3\. Quality Control**

* Own quality control for the portfolio, personally reviewing proofs for spelling, grammar, tracking codes, offer accuracy, and recipient\-versus\-mailed\-store logic before anything reaches the client.
* Verify job details against the job order before issuing to the print department, catching discrepancies at the point where they are still cheap to fix.
* Treat quality standards as something to strengthen, not just apply: build and refine checklists, and capture the lessons from near\-misses so they don't recur.
* Maintain complete, accurate documentation — signed IOs, approved proofs, and job records filed correctly in Dropbox.

**4\. Client Communication**

* Keep clients informed and confident across the full arc of a project, from insertion order through creative, production, and in\-home delivery.
* Communicate with precision: clear next steps, explicit owners, real dates, and no ambiguity about what is needed from whom.
* Facilitate and lead client\-facing calls on production status, timelines, and approvals.
* Deliver difficult news early and well — a timeline slip surfaced today with a plan attached is a manageable conversation; the same slip surfaced at launch is not.
* Manage client expectations actively so that what's promised and what's delivered stay aligned.

**5\. Production, Creative \& Vendor Coordination**

* Facilitate the creative process end to end: templates to the client, client assets received on schedule, and clean handoff to creative services for production preparation.
* Interface with the print department to manage production schedules and requirements, aligning client approvals to press timing.
* Plan and oversee distribution of direct mail pieces, ensuring timely arrival at destination.
* Interface with targeting vendors for list purchases where data team involvement isn't required.

**6\. Financial Hygiene \& Order Management**

* Issue insertion orders directly to clients and drive follow\-up to ensure payment is received per terms before programs release to print.
* Manage the invoicing process for assigned accounts, ensuring accurate and timely billing.
* Protect company cash flow by treating payment milestones with the same rigor as production milestones.

**7\. Process Improvement \& Team Contribution** ***(growth scope)***

* Identify friction in existing workflows and propose or implement better approaches — templates, SOPs, automations, checklists.
* Serve as a resource to junior coordinators, sharing knowledge and modeling standards; grow into formal mentorship as the team scales.
* Help onboard new team members into delivery processes and tools.

**Experience**

* 4–6\+ years in project management, campaign operations, production coordination, or account coordination, with demonstrated ownership of delivery outcomes.
* Direct mail, print production, or marketing agency experience strongly preferred; familiarity with print timelines, postal logistics, and proofing cycles is a significant advantage.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field preferred.

**Attention to Detail**

* Exceptional accuracy

**About OPR**


Olshan Patient Relations (OPR) is a boutique patient engagement consulting firm that helps pharmaceutical companies integrate patient and caregiver perspectives throughout drug development and commercialization. We serve as a strategic partner to clients, delivering work that is decision\-enabling, scientifically responsible, and respectful of patients, caregivers, and advocates.

  

  

**Position overview**


OPR is seeking an Associate of Client Services to manage a program for a major pharmaceutical client that is focused on embedding the patient perspective in US drug development initiatives during and after product launch. This associate will manage the end\-to\-end process for the client’s US Patient Insight Panels (PIPs), working in close partnership with members of the US Patient Advocacy team and their internal cross\-functional colleagues.


PIPs are organized by disease areas and are comprised of patients, caregivers, and patient advocates who have year\-long consulting agreements with the client to provide feedback on the company’s patient\-facing initiatives such as marketing programs, disease awareness campaigns, patient education, patient support services, and patient experience research. The PIPs are part of the US Patient Advocacy team’s strategy to collaborate with relevant patient communities to understand unmet needs that inform business strategy, mobilize patients to seek the best care and reduce access barriers. Consultations with PIP advisors are entirely virtual.


The client has separate PIPs for various disease areas, including but not limited to:


* Oncology
* Cardiovascular disease
* Immune disorders
* Rare diseases

This individual will be an employee of OPR and will report administratively to OPR, while working day to day under the direction of the client’s US Patient Advocacy team.

  

  

**Key responsibilities**


The client’s US Patient Advocacy department is run internally by Patient Advocacy Leads, each of whom sets strategy and leads collaboration with patient communities from different disease areas. Every Patient Advocacy Lead manages a PIP in their respective disease area. It will be the responsibility of OPR’s Associate of Client Services to provide support to each Patient Advocacy Lead to manage their respective PIPs. This will include:


* Conducting regular update calls with Patient Advocacy Leads to assess their needs
* Managing the process of setting up PIPs in each disease area at the beginning of every year and reconciling PIPs at the end of every year
* Managing timelines, deliverables, meeting preparation, follow\-up, and documentation for PIP projects
* Serving as the primary liaison between internal project teams and PIP advisors, ensuring effective and appropriate engagement throughout project lifecycles
* Maintaining accurate project records, documentation, tracking tools, and databases
* Monitoring advisor participation and project hours to support payment processes
* Identifying opportunities to improve PIP processes, templates, and project workflows, and maintaining and updating PIP standard operating procedures to align with evolving company practices
* Serving as a subject matter expert on the PIP consulting model, providing guidance and answering questions from advisors and internal cross\-functional colleagues
* Anticipating client needs and proactively identifying issues, risks, and next steps
* Helping to maintain strong client relationships through clear, responsive, and thoughtful communication
* Following all applicable laws and client policies, and reporting any instances of non\-compliance to the client’s Legal and Compliance departments
* Promoting the responsible use of AI\-enabled tools to strengthen PIP program quality, consistency, and efficiency

Training will be provided on OPR’s PIP processes, client systems, and relevant tools.

  

  

**Qualifications**


***Required***


* Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, public health, communications, healthcare administration, social sciences, or a related field
* Experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, healthcare consulting, patient advocacy, patient engagement, medical affairs, clinical development, or a related healthcare field
* Strong project management skills, including the ability to manage timelines, details, and multiple workstreams
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Experience working with clients, internal stakeholders, or external partners
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment
* Strong judgment, professionalism, and attention to detail

* Interest in patient\-centered healthcare and the importance of integrating patient and caregiver perspectives throughout drug development and commercialization

***Preferred***

* Experience supporting advisory boards, insight panels, interviews, workshops, or qualitative research
* Ability to translate scientific or clinical topics into clear, patient\-friendly language
* Consulting, agency, or client\-service experience
* Experience working with AI enabled tools

Full\-time OPR employees receive a benefits package that includes health insurance, a Simple IRA with company contribution and match, and paid time off for vacation, sick days and holidays.

**About the team and the role**
-------------------------------


Mind Robotics is building intelligent robotic systems. Our work happens on\-site across active hardware labs, test floors, and compute environments where hardware and software iterate together daily.


As our first dedicated IT hire, you will build and own our IT operations end to end. You’ll be responsible for making sure our teams never lose momentum to tooling, identity, device, or network issues, whether that means troubleshooting a Linux/driver setup in the lab, setting up zero\-touch laptop provisioning for new hires, or ensuring our test\-floor Wi\-Fi can handle high\-throughput robot telemetry.


We believe modern IT should be built for extreme leverage. In this role, you will actively use AI agents and build agentic workflows (leveraging LLMs, MCP, and API integrations) to automate support intake, triage, provisioning, access approvals, and system reconciliation. You'll build an AI\-native IT foundation that keeps operations fast, lean, and scalable without scaling support headcount.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own internal IT \& support: Be the primary technical point of contact for the team. Establish a lightweight, responsive support workflow that unblocks engineers quickly without unnecessary red tape.
* Build agentic automations \& workflows: Leverage AI coding agents and LLM\-driven workflows (via APIs, MCP, webhooks) to automate repetitive IT operations: such as intelligent ticket triage, access requests, onboarding/offboarding, and system reconciliation.
* Manage identity, access, and endpoints: Administer our core SaaS, identity, and access stack (Google Workspace / IdP) and deploy modern MDM (e.g., Fleet, Jamf) for zero\-touch provisioning and fleet visibility across macOS, Windows, and Linux machines.
* Support robotics lab \& compute infrastructure: Help maintain our lab workstation fleet (Ubuntu boxes, test bench PCs), keeping configurations reliable and reproducible.
* Design and maintain office \& lab networking: Manage local network infrastructure \- VLAN segmentation (isolating robot telemetry, test benches, and corporate traffic), Wi\-Fi reliability in dense RF lab environments, managed switches, and ISP circuits.
* Manage hardware \& procurement: Own hardware ordering, inventory tracking, vendor relationships, conference room AV, and hands\-on physical lab IT setup (racking, cabling, and workstation rollouts).

**Requirements**
----------------

* Experience: 6\+ years of hands\-on IT operations, systems administration, or IT engineering experience, ideally in a fast\-paced startup, hardware, or robotics environment.
* AI \& Agentic fluency: Active user of AI coding tools and agents (Cursor, Claude Code, LLM APIs) to accelerate development, with experience or strong interest in building agentic/LLM\-assisted workflows for operations.
* Multi\-OS troubleshooting: Strong troubleshooting skills across macOS, Windows, and Linux (Ubuntu) at the OS, driver, and application layers.
* Networking fundamentals: Practical hands\-on experience configuring managed switches, subnets, VLANs, DNS/DHCP, VPN, and robust Wi\-Fi networks.
* AI \& MCP integrations: Experience deploying LLM agents, MCP servers, or AI\-native internal tools useing Python, JS, Git, or Bash for IT/Ops automation.
* Identity \& MDM: Hands\-on experience administering nterprise identity (Google Workspace, Okta) and modern MDM platforms (Fleet, Jamf, Intune, or equivalent).
* Hands\-on facility readiness: Willingness to work on\-site and handle physical infrastructure: racking equipment, running and terminating cable, and supporting all types of hardware in an active lab and office environment.
* Robotics \& ML: Experience supporting robotics environments, ROS, or GPU/CUDA machine learning workstations (is a plus).
* Facility scaling: Experience managing IT infrastructure through a new facility buildout or office/lab move (is a plus).

At **ModMed**, we’re not just building software—we’re reimagining the healthcare experience. Founded in 2010 by a practicing physician and a successful tech entrepreneur, we took a radically different approach: **we hired doctors and taught them how to code.** This "for doctors, by doctors" philosophy has allowed us to create an AI\-enabled, specialty\-specific cloud platform that places patients at the center of care.

**A Culture of Excellence**


When you join ModMed, you’re joining an award\-winning team recognized for innovation and employee satisfaction. From our global headquarters in Boca Raton Florida, and extensive employee base in Hyderabad India, we are a team of 4,500\+ passionate problem\-solvers on a mission to increase medical practice success and improve patient outcomes:

* **Consistently ranked as a Top Place to Work**
* **2025 Globee Business Awards:** Gold Globee for “Technology Team of the Year”
* **2025 Black Book Awards:** Ranked \#1 EHR in 11 Specialties
* **Florida Venture Forum:** Venture\-Backed Company of the Year

new_jobs.description:
**Former Admissions Officer (Account Manager)**
===============================================

**Full\-time \| Remote****Who We Are**
--------------


Prepory is a premier college admissions counseling company. Our innovative, holistic approach is reshaping how students apply to college, find their fit, and earn admission to their dream schools. We've guided more than 20,000 students across 80\+ countries, and we routinely help our students earn admission to the nation's most selective colleges and universities.  

Through our college admissions practice, we work one\-on\-one with students from as early as 8th grade, helping them build an intentional extracurricular profile, craft compelling essays, and navigate every step of the application process. We hold ourselves to an excellent record of success by gearing our services to genuinely counsel the students, families, and institutions we serve.**About This Role**
-------------------


The Former Admissions Officer (Account Manager) is the person our parents hear from most. You'll own the relationship between Prepory and the parents and guardians of the students we serve, from the orientation calls through final admissions decisions, and you'll make sure the experience a family signed up for is the experience they actually get.  

This is a client\-facing, relationship\-driven role. You'll run new student orientations and parent check\-in meetings, serve as the escalation point when a family's expectations and a coach's approach fall out of alignment, and mentor our college admissions coaches on how to navigate hard conversations and complicated family dynamics. When a family is ready to add programming or re\-enroll for another year, you'll be the person they trust enough to ask.  

You'll also maintain a cohort of up to 15 students. That caseload is deliberately small, because the majority of your hours belong to client success. Coaching a few students keeps you close to the advising experience you represent to parents every day.  

You'll report to our Client Success Director and work alongside our Program Directors, Program Managers, Enrollment team, and coaching team. **What You'll Do**

### **Own the family relationship**

* Conduct new student orientation sessions that set clear expectations for the program and each family's role in it.
* Run parent check\-in meetings alongside the student's coach, translating student progress into terms families understand and can act on.
* Communicate proactively with parents and guardians so concerns surface early, while there's still time to solve them.
* Serve as the point of escalation for families whose expectations, needs, or dynamics call for a steadier hand, and know when to bring in the Client Success Director.
* Handle difficult conversations with disappointed or anxious families directly, calmly, and with a solutions\-oriented attitude.

### **Support and protect the coaching relationship**

* Serve as the point of contact and escalation for college admissions coaches navigating client concerns, expectations, and family dynamics.
* Mentor coaches on client communication, individualized student needs, and the situations that don't have a playbook.
* Collaborate with coaches and program leadership to adjust programming when a student's needs change.

### **Grow the relationship**

* Recognize when a family is ready for more, and introduce the Prepory programming that fits: college tours, UK admissions support, graduate and professional school admissions, and enrichment and research planning.
* Own re\-enrollments for the families you serve, and carry the commercial conversation with the same care you bring to every other conversation.
* Champion referral and review strategies, including mentoring coaches on leveraging their relationship with families to drive positive reviews and referrals to friends and family.

### **Coach a cohort of up to 15 students**

* Conduct regular one\-on\-one advising sessions with your students, from profile building through final decisions.
* Advise students through the writing process for personal statements, supplemental essays, and résumés, providing meaningful, actionable feedback.
* Track each student's deadlines and assign tasks between sessions to keep them on pace.
* Help students research and build a balanced college list that reflects their academic and professional interests.

 **What You Bring**

* Admissions knowledge you can draw on in real time. You'll be on live calls with families who ask hard, specific questions. You need to answer most of them with confidence, and recognize the rest quickly enough to say you'll follow up rather than guess.
* Composure with any family in the room. Orientations and check\-ins put you in front of every kind of parent, from the entirely hands\-off to the deeply anxious.
* Real comfort with the commercial side of the work. We are looking for someone who is excited when a conversation turns to renewals, add\-on programming, or enrolling a second child, and who treats it as the natural extension of a relationship they've earned.
* Availability to work at least one evening per week and 12 Saturdays or Sundays per year.
* Impeccable listening, speaking, writing, and grammar skills, along with excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* The ability to manage competing priorities in a fast\-moving environment, including peak season, when orientations, check\-ins, and application deadlines all land at once.

**Qualifications of Our Ideal Candidate**
-----------------------------------------

* Graduated from a selective or highly\-selective college or university (top\-50 national university or top\-20 liberal arts college preferred).
* Three or more years of experience in college admissions, admissions consulting, or a closely related field. Experience inside an admissions office is a strong plus.
* Detailed, current knowledge of the U.S. college admissions process, and a willingness to stay current

new_jobs.title: Technical Field Operations Manager - Special Hazards
new_jobs.description:
Reporting to the Vice President, IFP, this role combines technical leadership, people management, resource planning, and field operations oversight with involvement in project estimating and planning. You’ll lead a team of Field Technicians, serve as a senior technical resource for complex field challenges, and work closely with Project Management, Sales, and Engineering to ensure projects are accurately scoped, appropriately staffed, and successfully executed from installation through commissioning and closeout.


*This position is classified as remote and can be located anywhere in the United States, with a preference for candidates located in Kansas, Indiana, Texas, or Arizona.*


**We think you’ll thrive if:**


* You’re an experienced fire protection professional who can confidently lead both people and technical execution.
* You enjoy developing technicians, setting clear expectations, and building a team that operates with accountability and consistency.
* You’re comfortable solving complex field problems and making sound decisions when conditions don’t go according to plan.
* You can balance people, schedules, customer needs, project demands, and business priorities in a fast\-moving environment.
* You understand that strong field execution starts before anyone arrives on site and can bring a practical field perspective to estimating, planning, and project handoffs.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Lead and manage Field Operations personnel, including workload prioritization, technical direction, performance expectations, coaching, development, and accountability.
* Plan and allocate field resources across active projects in coordination with Project Management and Sales.
* Oversee installation, commissioning, acceptance testing, and service activities to support safe, compliant, high\-quality, and timely project execution.
* Serve as a senior technical escalation resource for complex fire suppression, fire alarm, installation, equipment, commissioning, and field issues.
* Lead troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis involving system failures, false discharges, deficiencies, and other complex technical conditions.
* Provide technical direction to Field Technicians and subcontractors regarding installation challenges, design clarifications, testing, and commissioning requirements.
* Build the technical capability of the Field Operations team through training, coaching, standardization, cross\-training, and certification development.
* Establish and improve field processes, tools, templates, documentation standards, and workflows that improve consistency, productivity, safety, quality, and customer experience.
* Partner with Sales and Project Management during estimating and planning to review project requirements, plans, specifications, equipment needs, labor assumptions, and commissioning requirements.
* Identify scope gaps, technical risks, site conditions, and execution challenges that could affect project cost, schedule, or successful delivery.
* Assist with equipment takeoffs and technical inputs used to develop accurate project estimates and proposals.
* Review field labor performance and project outcomes to identify lessons learned and continuously improve future scoping, estimating, and execution.


**Experience \& Education**


*Required*


* 10\+ years of experience installing or servicing fire suppression systems.
* 3\+ years’ leadership experience overseeing contractor teams in construction, industrial environments, or related industries.
* Demonstrated technical knowledge of fire suppression systems, installation practices, commissioning, troubleshooting, and field execution.
* Proficient knowledge of applicable NFPA standards.
* Strong mechanical aptitude with hands\-on experience involving tubing, piping, pressure testing, hand tools, and related field equipment.
* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, schematics, and project specifications.
* Strong communication, leadership, problem\-solving, and organizational skills.
* Ability to effectively manage competing project demands, field resources, and priorities.
* Comfortable using mobile technology for reporting, work orders, testing, and field documentation.
* Ability to travel regionally and nationally up to 50% of the time.


*Preferred*


* NICET Fire Alarm and/or Special Hazards certification, with Level III preferred, or equivalent fire\-protection credentials.


**About Veridity**


**Engineered Safety for the World's Most Critical Environments.**


Veridity delivers fire and life safety solutions across energy, aviation, industrial, and mission\-critical environments, supporting detection, suppression, and system integration through a network of specialized companies. Our North American brands include SEVO Industrial Fire Protection (IFP), SEVO Systems, and M\-Source Machining. We are aligned by a shared mission, unified strategy, and relentless commitment to execution, innovation, and long\-term customer partnerships.


**About SEVO Industrial Fire Protection**  

SEVO Industrial Fire Protection (IFP) provides turnkey fire and life safety solutions including engineering, permitting, installation, commissioning, inspection, and ongoing service.
